answer: The zephyr counter is kept in grove and lagoon shows each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1913 identities would post 2252 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
